profile.headline: Principal Application Software Engineer, Oracle Health
profile.summary:
Principal Application Software Engineer -- Mapping legacy Cerner Millennium v500 DB to OCI forward and backward, is currently the name of the game.

Principal Integration Architect for Oracle Health and Artificial Intelligence. Provide expertise on Millennium EMR integration with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, specifically Oracle Clinical AI Agent.

Provider practice advisor for Investor Owned and Central

Physician Practice Advisor for American Academic Health System - Cerner project.

Sr. physician practice architect for LifePoint Health- Cerner project.

Sr. physician practice architect for IASIS HealthCare - Cerner project.

Sr. physician practice architect for Community Health Systems - Cerner project.

Sr. physician practice architect for Glens Falls Hospital - EMR displacement outpatient and physician optimization inpatient.

Part time physician practice lead for AtlantiCare ambulatory initiatives.

positions.title: Principal Application Software Engineer
positions.insights: Cloud Applications, Software Development and +2 skills

positions.title: Principal Consultant | Provider Practice - Investor Owned
positions.description:
•	Lead solution strategy and accountability for highly complex multi-site client programs and new market expansions
•	Provide governance over solution implementation to consulting team and clients to ensure on time and within budget custom implementations are met
•	Drive solution and methodology enhancement strategies amongst Provider Practice span to advance technology and hospital and physician practice outcomes
•	Serve as the final point of escalation to resolve technical and operational issues and risks; maintaining relationship with Cerner and client C-suite personnel, engineers and executives
•	Review and discover sales contracts and project scoping documents regarding complex technologies for new and existing clients, resulting in additional projects and client contracts
•	Design and originate custom technology solutions to improve provider and clinician satisfaction with Electronic Medical Records with coding and Cerner Command Language skillset and expertise
•	Utilize current state data to measure the impact of system modifications and report findings to C-suite and executives, resulting in business improvements and positive outcomes
•	Define and translate both technical and clinical knowledge to provide seamless communication between end users and technology stakeholders
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Resource Allocation and +5 skills

positions.title: Manager | Clinical Consulting Provider Practice
positions.description:
• Managed up to six senior level managers providing guidance on solution knowledge, client obligations, and daily deliverables across span of approximately eighteen consultants
• Mentored and inspired several direct reports from young associates into current senior leadership positions
• Retained and grew over 90% of all direct reports throughout the course of my management role
• Operated as formal escalation point for internal risks, problems, and issues, and often predicted escalations before they occurred too late in the project
• Collaborated amongst leadership committees meeting weekly to discuss upcoming projects and areas of opportunity and improvement
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Resource Allocation and +5 skills

positions.title: Consultant | Provider Practice Investor Owned & Federal
positions.description:
• Empowered Providers to utilize advanced technology to improve patient experience and financial goals by adopting Key Performance Indicators and standardizing an electronic medical record platform amongst all patient care departments
• Designed and optimized Provider Practice solutions for over 200 Investor Owned acute hospitals and thousands of clinics through implementation of standardized workflows and health care policies which led to increased efficiency and patient throughput
• Presented and demonstrated finalized workflows and configuration to ensure accurate system design
• Focused on people, process and technology to drive impactful outcomes for providers and patients
positions.insights: Relational Databases, Healthcare Industry and +2 skills
